title: Freestanding Coat Rack 60-Inch Brass Assorted Free Standing Accessorie - | Satin Nickel | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a freestanding coat rack that adds hanging space without wall mounting, crafted from brass and designed with pivoting pegs in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms.

  • Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Floor protection: felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces
  • Organized hanging: pivoting pegs for robes, towels, and accessories
  • Coordinated look: complements traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures

Specs

  • Dimensions: 60-Inch H x 10-Inch W x 10-Inch L
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Weight capacity: 18 lb
  • Product weight: 14.4 lb
  • Assembly required: Yes
  • Included: Freestanding coat rack

Finish options

Available in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors.
